text:
Maria: incidentbot fired PD: high latency spike on tacoma-serving-01, group=runtime-p99, region=us-west-2
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD12345 (service: runtime-latency). Auto-escalation in 2m.
pagerduty-bot: Incident created: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD12345 :rotating_light:
AJ: on it, grabbing logs and checking recent deploys
Eli: I see a short burst from the tacoma cluster, rotor autoscaler ticked, some pods OOM-killed around the same time
Sam: any customer-facing errors? top-level dashboards look green for errors, only latency bump in internal SLO dashboard
AJ: digging into tail of `tacoma-serving-01` logs, here's a snippet:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:34Z WARN kv-cache miss spike for prefix user-sessions, latency 1.8s
2026-03-15T10:12:36Z INFO batcher flush delay 120ms -> 800ms backlog
2026-03-15T10:12:37Z ERROR process OOM killed
```
Eli: looks like a KV-prefill storm + one unlucky pod OOMed which increased queueing for the rest
Maria: acked PD, please annotate if we need to suppress duplicates
AJ: acked PD12345 :white_check_mark: starting mitigation plan: 1) scale tacoma pool +1, 2) restart failed pod, 3) enable temporary PD suppression window for same alert fingerprint
Sam: I can flip the suppression for 5m under PD policy `runtime-transient`
incidentbot: PagerDuty escalation in 1m unless acknowledged by responder
Eli: restarted pod, verifying readiness probes, `kubectl get pods -n tacoma` shows 2/3 back to Ready within 30s
AJ: scaling tacoma pool (autoscaler override +1) now, command: `kube-ops override scale tacoma-serving --replicas=6`
Sam: suppression set for 5m for fingerprint `f7a3b9` to avoid flap spam :thumbsup:
Maria: quick perf graphs look like p99 returning toward baseline already, can we hold on full rollback?
Eli: agree, not seeing error increase for customers, no 5xx spike in APIGW logs
AJ: marking customer-impact: none (internal latency only). Will monitor for 10m then clear PD
Sam: PD incident marked as acknowledged and suppression active, adding note to incident: transient KV-prefill + single OOM -> backlog
Maria: thanks team. follow-up: create INC ticket for runbook update and autoscaler tuning (INC-4975). Eli can you own?
Eli: yep will open INC-4975 and add playbook steps for prefix-KV spikes, and a knob to bump batcher flush threshold
incidentbot: PagerDuty incident PD12345 status changed: acknowledged by AJ
AJ: last check: p95/p99 trending down, autoscaler is absorbing load. keeping oncall until 10:40 UTC then hand off to next shift if stable
Sam: leaving a short snippet to paste in postmortem: "Transient KV-prefill caused short latency spike; single pod OOM amplified backlog; autoscaler + restart + temporary PD suppression mitigated; no customer impact."
Maria: agreed. closing thread once PD auto-resolves. thanks all :pray:
